update.title: Moved Portfolio Editor into its managed worktree
update.summary: Re-rooted tracked files and configuration around the package worktree, then clarified report identities in the editor interface.

blocks.body:
## Make the package own its repository paths

Portfolio Editor’s tracked files now use paths relative to its worktree. Repository commands describe the package itself, while runtime configuration reads the shared workspace root through one boundary instead of duplicating path resolution inside the editor.

blocks.code:
Before: tracked paths depended on a shared home-directory worktree
After:  repository root contains package-relative paths

Application paths come from package configuration.
Test imports come from declared test configuration.
blocks.description: The migration aligned version-control identity, runtime configuration, and tests around the same package root.

blocks.body:
## Keep editor records easy to cross-reference

Report cards now show the stable ID used by report commands and logs. The sidebar, CLI, and diagnostics can point to the same record without relying on title matching.
